As demand for sustainable financial solutions continues to accelerate, Personal and Private Banking
has identified three strategic focus areas for 2026 to further embed sustainability into growth and
value creation.
• As customer demand for renewable energy and clean‑technology solutions is rising, we will
explore enhanced financing mechanisms to support the adoption of solar and other clean‑energy
technologies, enabling households to transition to lower‑carbon energy sources while reducing
long‑term energy costs.
• Deepen our impact in financial inclusion by extending credit access to underserved customer
segments, allocating additional liquidity towards sustainability‑linked lending, and refining digital
lending platforms to improve reach, affordability and speed to market.
• Intensify efforts to embed sustainability thinking across the business. Enhanced staff
engagement initiatives will ensure sustainability considerations are integrated into credit
decisions, client advisory processes and product development frameworks, strengthening
internal ownership and accountability.
